scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @handover/server generate && pnpm --filter @handover/web generate && pnpm --filter @handover/cli generate
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/universal --noEmit
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig apps/server/tsconfig.json apps/server && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/web && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig apps/cli/tsconfig.json apps/cli && oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig packages/universal/tsconfig.json packages
scripts.check: pnpm generate && git diff --exit-code apps/server/generated && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm test
